gloss: highest score; highest point; maximum mark

definitions.gloss: highest score; top mark; maximum points
definitions.explanation: The best or highest score achieved in a test, competition, or evaluation. Commonly used in academic and competitive contexts.
The physically or figuratively highest point of something, such as the peak of a mountain range or the pinnacle of a career.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最高点|さいこうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧98⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧だった。
examples.english: The highest score on this test was 98 points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{最高点|さいこうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: She got the top score in the class.

examples.japanese: {全教科|ぜんきょうか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{最高点|さいこうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現実的|げんじつてき}→現実的：04794_genjitsuteki⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Aiming for the top score in every subject is not realistic.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山脈|さんみゃく}→山脈：07856_sanmyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最高点|さいこうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3,000⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The highest point of this mountain range exceeds 3,000 meters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧{最高点|さいこうてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: Stock prices reached an all-time high.

examples.japanese: {選手生活|せんしゅせいかつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最高点|さいこうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{選手権|せんしゅけん}→選手権：14432_senshuken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧だった。
examples.english: The peak of his athletic career was the gold medal at the world championship.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧ (highest; best) and ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point; score). The academic sense is by far the most common in everyday use. In Japanese schools, test scores are a frequent topic of conversation, and {最高点|さいこうてん} appears regularly in school announcements and discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最高点|さいこうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get the highest score
- {最高点|さいこうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧: to record the highest score
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧{最高点|さいこうてん}: all-time high score/point

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最低点|さいていてん}→最低点：25792_saiteiten⟧: lowest score/point — the opposite
- ⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧: perfect score — the maximum possible score, not just the best achieved
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: highest; the best — the broader adjective/noun without the specific 'point/score' meaning
